cohort: 539 viable dichorionic-diamniotic (DCDA) twin pregnancies delivered at Cork University Maternity Hospital, Ireland between 2009 and 2012
finding: While twin pregnancies conceived through ART were more likely to be delivered via cesarean section and moderately preterm, there were no significant differences in other obstetric and perinatal outcomes compared to naturally conceived twin pregnancies.
mod_finding: ART conceived twins were twice as likely to be delivered by caesarean section (CS) (OR 2.35; 95% CI 1.76-3.14).
